description.value: Good Fortune Restaurant is a family-run Chinese food restaurant in Sidney, BC, celebrated locally as 'Sidney's Finest Chinese Food' and known especially for its Ginger Fried Beef. Meals are prepared fresh to order in a licensed dining room, with catering and delivery also available. Cyclists passing through Sidney will find a full dine-in experience alongside takeout options and a menu that accommodates gluten-free and MSG-free dietary needs.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 43m; stands (10 spaces) at 84m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded successfully and corroborates all OSM contact details (phone, address, website URL). The menu page explicitly lists a Vegetarian section and the homepage confirms gluten-free and MSG-free options available on request, supporting the GF/vegetarian amenity. Takeout is confirmed by 'place an order to go' language and a stated discount for pick-up orders; no bike-specific amenities (parking, Wi-Fi, charging, pump) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible Chinese restaurant in Sidney with a functioning website and confirmed contact details. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a full meal with dietary accommodation options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page includes a dedicated Vegetarian section; homepage states 'plenty of options free from gluten and MSG, available upon request ahead of time.'

wow_evidence: family-run Chinese food restaurant... celebrated locally as 'Sidney's Finest Chinese Food'
